name: Communion Of Saints
overview: The Communion of Saints is beautifully illustrated in Scripture as the unity and mutual care among believers, exemplified by David's depiction of brethren dwelling together in unity as pleasant and good, like precious ointment and refreshing dew that brings God's blessing (Psalms 133:1-3). The apostolic example further emphasizes this fellowship through prayer and emotional support, as seen when Paul knelt to pray with the believers who wept and embraced him deeply upon his departure (Acts 20:36-38). These passages highlight the spiritual bond and encouragement that characterize the true fellowship of the saints.
